common_public_record: On 18 December 2017, at meeting S/PV.8139, the Security Council considered Egypt's draft S/2017/1060 on Jerusalem, submitted on behalf of the Group of Arab States. The draft received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The sole negative vote came from the United States. The chair declared the draft unadopted because of the negative vote of a permanent member. The failed draft created no new Council obligations.

calibrated.focal_slip: Nikki Haley gave the United States' explanation of its negative vote following the ballot.
calibrated.reply_note: On the date of the veto, Haley stated it defended U.S. sovereignty and its role in the Middle East peace process. She asserted the United States decides embassy location, noting that recognizing Jerusalem did not prejudge final status or boundaries to be negotiated by the parties. This reflects Haley's position as the source of these assertions regarding the Council's action.
